title: After the Long Journey Will the Door Open for You?
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh addresses a group of Italian mureeds.)
Allahu, Allahu, Allahu Haqq! 3x
Haqq al-Haqq subhaanahu wa Ta`alaa!
Allahuma thabitna` ala ‘l-Haqq!
Fatihah.
May Allah give you happiness here and Hereafter with your children. We hope that when Mahdi (a) comes
and seven big nations will come to Islam, I hope inshaa-Allah that Italians will be, from beginning up to end,
saying, “Laa ilaaha illa-Llah Muhammadun Rasoolullah,” to be Muslim! May Allah bless you! Happy days for
you, you are very welcome and if anyone is asking to stay longer you may stay, or if your tickets are fixed you
must follow your tickets and have a safe, happy journey and a good future for you inshaa-Allah! All Italians
coming to say, “Laa ilaaha illa-Llah Muhammadun Rasoolullah.”
Look around yourself for the good ones. Allah is blessing you! (Mawlana Shaykh gives baya’) Allahu, Allahu,
Allahu Haqq! Happy days.

(A group of Spanish mureeds arrive.)
Happy journey, you are welcome! Keep the ways of Heavens, because finally we are moving from here up to
Heavens. Therefore, keep on training your physical being to help your spiritual being, as that gives your
spirituality much more of a chance to be for your heavenly being. But people now are trying to make their
physical being happy and enjoyful, and they are leaving their spiritual being, not looking after it.
Therefore, all of you must try to give much more time and work for your spiritual being, because we don’t
know when we are going to be called by Heavens. Some people are reaching up to their heavenly station and
asking to enter, but they are not given permission to go in. It is not opening because they were giving all their
energy for their physical being, and therefore those doors to their heavenly being are never opening. So, give
much more time and activity for your spiritual being and then the doors are going to open, and you may say,
“Bomborido!” or you may say to those doors, “Kick them down!” and they open.
May Allah forgive you and forgive me, and make us to be servants to the Lord of Heavens! That is our way.
We are not quarrelling with people of other religions, we are only saying something that is written in their
holy books also. Everyone is going up! Their souls are reaching the Heavens and then the doors are either
opening and they enter, or they are thrown down and the doors stay closed on them and they may do
anything, as they like.
Fatihah.
Do you have anything to ask or say? Are you happy with us? We hope that He Almighty is going to be happy
with you and blessings come over us all!
Fatihah.
This is enough for everyone. (Mawlana stands and, at their request, gives some guests shahaadah. they
present gifts.) May Allah give you heavenly grants; as you are giving me gifts, may Allah give you heavenly
gifts to be happy! Are you happy with us? (Yes!) I am weak and I need rest, but so many of our brothers and
sisters are coming, and I am trying to be with you as much as possible.

(A German woman asks should she accept our way.)
She took shahaadah already. Laa ilaaha illa-Llah, Musa Rasoolullah! Laa ilaaha illa-Llah, Muhammadun
Rasoolullah! We accept all prophets and their holy books. The first prophet was Adam (a) and the last
prophet is Muhammad (s)!
(I love you!) We love you!
